propositions: 66af fix (token moved from query string to X-Rebar-Token header + TokenRedactingFilter) must be deployed to prod container before rotating the compromised token, else the new token will be immediately re-leaked in plaintext logs.

GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret used simultaneously for outbound Gerrit HTTP basic-auth, inbound webhook header validation, and container environment; rotation must use service-user.sh to keep these three synchronized via Gerrit password update, SSM parameter write, and webhooks.config push.

Rotation procedure requires: deploy 66af code, run service-user.sh to set new token in Gerrit password + SSM + webhooks.config, restart review-bot container, and verify end-to-end (inbound webhook triggers review AND outbound LLM-Review vote succeeds).
The previously-logged compromised token remains valid and must be rotated; until rotation completes the credential exposure is open.
